description: This file defines the 'ContactsController' class, a controller in a web application that manages various contact-related actions such as displaying popups and validating usernames.

classes.name: ContactsController
classes.description: A controller class managing contact-related popup actions and view rendering in the SuiteCRM application.

methods.name: action_Popup
methods.description: Handles displaying the mail merge popup or generic popup based on request parameters.

methods.name: action_ValidPortalUsername
methods.description: Sets the view to validate portal usernames.

methods.name: action_RetrieveEmail
methods.description: Sets the view to retrieve email addresses.

methods.name: action_ContactAddressPopup
methods.description: Displays the contact address popup view.

methods.name: action_CloseContactAddressPopup
methods.description: Closes the contact address popup view.
